select , p.name as project_name, coalesce(ua.nick_name, ua.user_name) as assignee_name, coalesce(uc.nick_name, uc.user_name) as creator_name from oa_task_recur r left join oa_project p on p.project_id = r.project_id left join sys_user ua on ua.user_id = r.assignee_id left join sys_user uc on uc.user_id = r.creator_id
mapper.select: select from oa_task_recur r where r.recur_id = #{recurId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into oa_task_recur (title, description, project_id, week_days, due_time, assignee_id, priority, tags, start_date, status, next_date, creator_id, dept_id, create_by, create_time) values (#{title}, #{description}, #{projectId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{weekDays}, #{dueTime}, #{assigneeId}, #{priority}, #{tags}, #{startDate}, '0', #{nextDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{creatorId}, #{deptId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update oa_task_recur set title = #{title}, description = #{description}, project_id = #{projectId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, week_days = #{weekDays}, due_time = #{dueTime}, assignee_id = #{assigneeId}, priority = #{priority}, tags = #{tags}, start_date = #{startDate}, next_date = #{nextDate,jdbcType=DATE}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where recur_id = #{recurId} and status <> '2'
update oa_task_recur set status = #{status}, next_date = #{nextDate,jdbcType=DATE}, update_time = sysdate() where recur_id = #{recurId} and status <> '2'
update oa_task_recur set next_date = #{nextDate,jdbcType=DATE}, update_time = sysdate() where recur_id = #{recurId} and status <> '2'
mapper.select: select from oa_task_recur r where r.status = '0' and r.start_date <= #{today} and find_in_set(#{weekday}, r.week_days) order by r.recur_id asc
select from oa_task_recur r where r.status = '0' and r.assignee_id = #{assigneeId} order by r.recur_id asc
select from oa_task_recur r where r.status = '0' and r.project_id = #{projectId} order by r.recur_id asc
